data.name: CH2_Chatot_1
data.value: This is the guild's second underground floor.

data.name: CH2_Chatot_2
data.value: This is mainly where the apprentices work.

data.name: CH2_Chatot_3
data.value: Team registration is this way. Come along, please.

data.name: CH2_PARTNER_1
data.value: Wow! We're two floors under the ground, but you can see outside!

data.name: CH2_Chatot_4
data.value: Oh, please! Hush now!

data.name: CH2_Chatot_5
data.value: The guild is built into the side of a cliff.

data.name: CH2_Chatot_6
data.value: It's only natural that you would be able to see outside.

data.name: CH2_PARTNER_2
data.value: Oh.

data.name: CH2_Chatot_7
data.value: Now, here we are at Guildmaster {0}'s chamber.

data.name: CH2_Chatot_8
data.value: On no account...[pause=0] I repeat, on no account should you be discourteous to our Guildmaster.

data.name: CH2_Chatot_9
data.value: Guildmaster![pause=0] It's {0}! ♪ I'm coming in!

data.name: CH2_S2_Loudred_1
data.value: You're LATE, rookies!

data.name: CH2_S2_Chatot_1
data.value: Hush!

data.name: CH2_S2_Chatot_2
data.value: Your voice is ridiculously loud!

data.name: CH2_S2_Loudred_2
data.value: Humph...

data.name: CH2_S2_Chatot_3
data.value: Everyone seems to be present.

data.name: CH2_S2_Chatot_4
data.value: Very well. ♪ Let us conduct our morning address.

data.name: CH2_S2_Chatot_5
data.value: Guildmaster! ♪ The guild is in full attendance! ♪

data.name: CH2_S2_Chatot_6
data.value: Thank you, Guildmaster! ♪ Please address the crew.

data.name: CH2_S2_Wigglytuff_1
data.value: Zzzz... Zzzz... Snorfle... Zzz...

data.name: CH2_S2_Unknown_1
data.value: (Psst...! Guildmaster {0} never ceases to amaze me!)

data.name: CH2_S2_Unknown_2
data.value: (Yeah, you got that right!)

data.name: CH2_S2_Unknown_3
data.value: (Yup, looks like he's wide awake.)

data.name: CH2_S2_Unknown_4
data.value: (Eek! His eyes are wide open! But he's fast asleep!)

data.name: CH2_S2_Chatot_7
data.value: Thank you, sir! We all value your...[pause=0]words of wisdom! ♪

data.name: CH2_S2_Chatot_8
data.value: OK, Pokémon! ♪ Take our Guildmaster's words of wisdom to heart! ♪

data.name: CH2_S2_Chatot_9
data.value: Finally, let's not forget our morning cheers! All together now! ♪

data.name: CH2_S2_ALL_1
data.value: A ONE, A TWO...A ONE-TWO-THREE!

data.name: CH2_S2_ALL_2
data.value: ONE![pause=0] DON'T SHIRK WORK!

data.name: CH2_S2_ALL_3
data.value: TWO![pause=0] RUN AWAY AND PAY!

data.name: CH2_S2_ALL_4
data.value: THREE![pause=0] SMILES GO FOR MILES!

data.name: CH2_S2_Chatot_10
data.value: OK, Pokémon! Get to work! ♪

data.name: CH2_S2_ALL_5
data.value: HOORAY!

data.name: CH2_S3_Chatot_1
data.value: Hey, you shouldn't just be wandering around there.

data.name: CH2_S3_Chatot_2
data.value: You two come here. ♪

data.name: C_Chimecho_1
data.value: Everyone![pause=0] Thanks for waiting! ♪

data.name: C_Chimecho_2
data.value: I finished making dinner! ♪

data.name: C_Chimecho_3
data.value: Come on! Dinner's on! ♪

data.name: C_ALL_1
data.value: YEAH!

data.name: C_2_Chatot_1
data.value: Ah, you two! ♪[pause=0] Let me give you your assignment for today...

data.name: C_2_Chatot_2
data.value: Look up jobs on the Job Bulletin Board and the Outlaw Notice Board.

data.name: C_2_Chatot_3
data.value: Do the listed jobs. That will do for today! ♪

data.name: C_2_Chatot_4
data.value: Understood? No shirking your work, OK?

data.name: C_2_Chatot_5
data.value: Well? If you understand, get on with it!

data.name: C_3_Chatot_1
data.value: Ah, you two! ♪[pause=0] Let me give you your assignment for today...

data.name: C_3_Chatot_2
data.value: Sentry duty! That's what we'll have you do today.

data.name: C_3_Chatot_3
data.value: I'll leave you to it! ♪

data.name: C_4_ALL_1
data.value: AND...THREE![pause=0] SMILES GO FOR MILES!
